messages.en:
{07 05 00}{01 08 00}GREAT GALLOPING PEANUTS!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 06 00}Why can't I catch any bugs?

{07 15 00}No, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! It's not
'cause I'm too slow!{01 00 00 03 00} These
bugs are too fast!
messages.et:
{07 05 00}{01 08 00}SUURED KARJUVAD KAERAD!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 06 00}Miks ma putukaid ei püüa?

{07 15 00}Ei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! Mitte see,
et ma aeglane oleksin!{01 00 00 03 00} Need
putukad on liiga kiired!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I've been looking, but I can
only seem to find the lame
ones!
{07 06 00}Just hold up, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
I'm not giving up until I
get a good one!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma olen otsinud, aga ma
leian ainult neid
igavaid!
{07 06 00}Oota natuke, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Ma ei anna alla, enne kui
saan ühe korraliku!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}For some reason, my
favorite bug is not showing
me any love! {01 00 00 05 00}Totally RUDE!
{07 16 00}Sorry, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}. Can you
just hold on for a little
while, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Millegipärast ei näita
mu lemmikputukas mulle
armastust! {01 00 00 05 00}Täiesti
EBAVIISAKAS! {07 16 00} Vabandust,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00} . Kas sa võid
natuke oodata, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
